Securitization sales—The Company’s securitization of its credit card receivables involves the sale to a trust
and is accomplished primarily through the public and private issuance of asset-backed securities by the qualified
special purpose entities. The Company removes credit card receivables from its Consolidated Balance Sheets for
those asset securitizations that qualify as sales in accordance with ASC 860, “Transfers and Servicing.” The
Company has determined that the WFN Trusts and the WFC Trust are qualifying special purpose entities as
defined by ASC 860 and that all current securitizations qualify as sales.

ADS_2009_p182__paragraph_1.ocr:
Taxes assessed on revenue-producing transactions described above are presented on a net basis, and are
excluded from revenues.

ADS_2009_p182__paragraph_2.ocr:
Earnings Per Share—Basic earnings per share is based only on the weighted average number of common
shares outstanding, excluding any dilutive effects of options or other dilutive securities. Diluted earnings per
share are based on the weighted average number of common and potentially dilutive common shares (dilutive
stock options, unvested restricted stock and other dilutive securities outstanding during the year).

The Company calculates the effect of its convertible senior notes, consisting of $805.0 million aggregate
principal amount of convertible senior notes due 2013 (the “Convertible Senior Notes due 2013”) and
$345.0 million aggregate principal amount of convertible senior notes due 2014 (the “Convertible Senior Notes
due 2014”), which can be settled in cash or shares of common stock, on diluted net income per share as if they
will be settled in cash as the Company has the intent to settle the convertible senior notes for cash. As a result,
the Company uses the treasury stock method to calculate the dilutive effect of the convertible senior notes.
